title: abutilon permolle
intro: Abutilon permolle, commonly known as the Egyptian mallow, is a plant species belonging to the Malvaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, fever, and skin problems, due to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Abutilon permolle include its ability to reduce inflammation, protect against infections, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Abutilon permolle include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
